description: Verified build cache only for the exact extracted upstream production path dependency closure. All files, executable bits, workspace manifests, configuration, and derived lockfile must match. The selected source is compiled for any difference.

lockfile_baseline.description: Derived extraction lock including the fixed bridge and its original CLI feature union; external package versions, sources and checksums remain pinned.

manifest_policy: All extracted workspace Cargo.toml files and the injected fixed bridge manifest are bound, since any crate can change shared dependency feature unification without a lockfile change. Ordinary source changes outside the host path dependency closure may reuse this build cache.
